intro: Fort Worth listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $23, while the city's typical non-climate 10x10 street rate is about $89/month, down 4.3% year over year. That is below Dallas, and below the combined Dallas–Fort Worth metro asking rent of $103. The promo is still not the six-month cost: fees and the first existing-customer increase land after move-in.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe city street rates). Storage Stats publishes the Dallas–Fort Worth metro only ($103 for a non-climate 10x10, updated Oct 28, 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish a Fort Worth city page.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled street rate ~$38; climate promos from about $10.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$58.

Most rented size. City average $89, down 4.3% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). The Dallas–Fort Worth metro asking rent is $103, down 8.7% YoY (Storage Stats) — that figure includes Dallas and is not averaged in here. Climate-controlled ~$102.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$134.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$171.

local_tips: Location drives price: StorageCafe lists Southland Terrace (~$58), Sylvania Park (~$71) and Handley Heights South (~$73) among the cheapest areas, while Primrose Crossing (~$222) and Stonegate (~$220) run highest. Downtown Fort Worth averages about $156.

On the same September 2026 10x10 comparison, Dallas's city street rate is about $106 and Fort Worth's is $89 (StorageCafe). Use the Fort Worth page, not the Dallas page, if the unit is west of the metro.
Fort Worth rates tend to be lowest around November and highest in August (StorageCafe). The seasonal swing in the all-units average is only a few dollars.

Fort Worth added about 115,000 sq ft in 2025, roughly 1.2% of inventory, and has about 6.4 sq ft per capita (StorageCafe). Storage Stats tracks 1,500+ facilities across the whole Dallas–Fort Worth metro.
StorageUnitCosts, which tracks 20 major cities, publishes Dallas but not Fort Worth. Every size on this page is a StorageCafe city street rate.
Extra Space's published example admin fee is $50, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more (StorageUnitCosts).
